name: shiplet-core
description: Source-preview release of Shiplet's Cloudflare-native artifact review platform.

scripts.build: npm run generate:public && wrangler deploy --dry-run && npm run build:support-workers
scripts.build:support-workers: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config workers/cloudflare-control-plane/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config workers/managed-runtime-gateway/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config workers/deny-egress/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.generate:public: node scripts/generate-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-avatar-presets.mjs && node scripts/generate-why-shiplet-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-platform-client.mjs && wrangler types
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test scripts/browser-session.test.mjs scripts/cli-subprocess.test.mjs scripts/support-service-migrations.test.mjs scripts/wordpress-plugin.test.mjs scripts/public-source-preview.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit:licenses && npm run audit:security
